title: Triangles stored on DOE land across the Nevada Test and Training Range

tellings.quote: triangles stored at yeah DOE owned lands across the Nevada test and training range.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that triangle-shaped craft are stored on land owned by the Department of Energy, the US agency that runs nuclear and weapons labs. He says this land lies across the Nevada Test and Training Range, a large military area in Nevada. If true, it would place secret craft in specific government hands.
